heading: Compensation: Reserve on active duty accepting from any person
lead: Any Reserve who, before being ordered to active duty, was receiving compensation from any person may, while he is on that duty, receive compensation from that person.

notes.text: Prior ProvisionsProvisions similar to those in this section were contained in section 1033 of this title, prior to repeal by Pub. L. 103–337, § 1662(g)(2).
Effective DateSection effective Dec. 1, 1994, except as otherwise provided, see section 1691 of Pub. L. 103–337, set out as a note under section 10001 of this title.

sourceCredit: (Added Pub. L. 103–337, div. A, title XVI, § 1662(g)(1), Oct. 5, 1994, 108 Stat. 2995.)
